name: The Lounge
description: Self-hosted IRC client that stays connected 24/7: notifications, link previews, emojis, and a responsive web UI.
compose:
services:
  thelounge:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/thelounge:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:9000"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
